Definition: from G4155; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled):--strangled.
BiblicalUsage: Pniktos means strangled, choked to death — an animal not properly bled. The Jerusalem council wrote to the Gentiles to abstain from things strangled in Acts 15:20, and repeated it in Acts 15:29 and Acts 21:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the council's care for a brother's conscience was worth more than a meal.
